# ContentFlow

> ContentFlow is an AI-powered content creation and cross-platform distribution platform built for YouTube and TikTok creators.

## Product Overview
- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 App Router + Tailwind CSS v4
- **Backend & Data**: Supabase PostgreSQL (with strict Row-Level Security), Edge Functions, and Cloudflare R2 object storage
- **AI Routing Policy**:
  - Plan A: User BYOK (OpenAI / Replicate) with server-side AES-256-GCM envelope encryption or per-request headers
  - Plan B: Cloudflare Workers AI
  - Plan C: Hugging Face Inference API fallback
  - Plan D: Explicit client-side transformers.js fallback notice
- **Quota & Billing Policy**:
  - Daily quotas reset at 00:00 UTC; monthly quotas reset on the 1st at 00:00 UTC
  - User-scoped exact-match AI cache hits do not consume daily generation quota
  - Tiers: Free ($0), Creator ($9), Pro ($29), Agency ($99) with USD/NGN Paystack server-side price tables

## Key Public Routes
- `/`: Marketing landing page, features, pricing, and FAQ
- `/login`: Creator sign-in
- `/signup`: Free workspace registration
- `/privacy`: Privacy Policy
- `/terms`: Terms of Service
- `/notes`: Architecture & Product Policy Notes
